description: A SIGN clause on a GROUP item that contains no signed numeric data description entry (kb/Work PB1319). THE EDGE IS QUOTED from both editions' texts (kb/Work PB3965): §1985:VI.5.12.3 SR1 admits the clause only on 'a numeric data description entry whose PICTURE contains the character 'S', or a group item containing at least one such numeric data description entry'; §2002:13.16.50.2 SR1 (and §2023:13.18.52.3 SR1, Annex E listing no SIGN change, so 2014 = 2023) admits 'an alphanumeric group item, national group item, or strongly-typed group item', and §2002:F.2 states the change, its item 124: 'A sign clause may be specified on any group item. Formerly, the group had to contain at least one numeric item.' (VCR row 7.40). Gated in ONE place, CheckSignClausesPass.
display: a SIGN clause on a group item with no signed numeric subordinate
